title: Ty Simpson: I've done what I can do, but can't control if I go in first round

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ty Simpson: I've done what I can do, but can't control if I go in first round
sources.description: Ty Simpson hopes to hear his name called in the first round of the draft, but the former Alabama quarterback is going to need to wait a little longer to find out if that will happen.
